Whether Gold 2 truly leaves F1’s route

options.text: Recognize Gold 2’s shift
Check the newly affected forward route
Choose or retain possession based on actual availability

options.text: Only D2 can now receive under all conditions

F1 must remain open because Gold 2 moved

Use D2 before checking whether the forward route is reachable
The first lane stays open

F1 or D2’s current visibility
The forecheck label alone

questions.prompt: Gold 3 fills F1’s route after Gold 2 leaves. What should change?
questions.explanation: Name Gold 3 as the new pressure, protect the puck, and use D2 only if the actual lane remains reachable.

options.text: Scan the forward option before arrival
Update the lane and puck quality
